horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Jadomacuriño y Guyataiba. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P32 — Jadomacuriño. Jadomacuriño: sturdy mature woman with broad angular long face, straight black SHORT chin hair, cream loose raw-fibre BELOW-KNEE garment with RED/charcoal asymmetric FRONT paper band and short uneven fringe, plain back. Simple fibre hairband with FOUR short red feathers to one side, two black-seed ear pendants, slender small pale QUILL nasal ornament. One short seed necklace of brown/cream pieces, ONE charcoal sweeping cheek stroke. Red/brown identity with distinct body and hair from Rikoño.
Reference 2: B08 — Milpés. 
Reference 3: L02 — Chagra — claros, cultivos y recorridos. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide shaded chagra beside one whole milpés palm B08 at warm dawn. ONE whole Jadomacuriño P32 in her red/charcoal cream fibre garment, short chin black hair, small scarlet side-feather band and pale nasal quill looks toward a dark-purple ripe fruit bunch at shoulder height. The bunch's single cast shadow on a large pale folded leaf becomes a quiet whole MALE SILHOUETTE, an ORIGINAL EDITORIAL representation of Guyataiba speaking from the racimo, without inventing a tiny god sitting inside the fruit. Her hand holds one fruit, no pregnancy anatomy or sexual scene. Whole woman, natural palm fronds and bunch fit; cultivated forest scale dominates.

VISIBLE CHECK: Mujer completa recibe voz del racimo mediante una sombra de interlocutor.

vertical.escena:
Use case: image editing. Edit OUR OWN AI-GENERATED paper-cut original, reference image 1. Make one independent full-bleed artwork in vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536.

CORRECTION:
Pull the camera BACK about 25 percent and recenter both adults. Show the ENTIRE seated Jidobe, including his right shoulder, right arm and full bench, inside the vertical canvas with clear margin. Keep the whole woman at left, all hands and feet, exactly one whole empty basket, her anteater-shaped shadow, their original nasal quills, feathers, clothes and the maloca interior. No additional people or props.

Preserve expressive physical matte cardstock, actual separated layer shadows, pale cut cross-sections, hand-cut curves, folded feather vanes and leaf midribs. Quiet natural paper-plane faces, no CGI, plastic or digital painting. The environment continues beyond all four borders; no frame, plinth or specimen-sheet layout. No printed text. Every principal whole body, head, hand, foot, wing and ornament tip must remain inside the canvas. Retain the original color relationships and traditional fibre covers. These are original editorial illustrations, not certified traditional symbols. No private photo, real-person likeness or ritual instructions.

MYTH: Jadomacuriño y Guyataiba. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: V19 — Jadomacuriño: oso hormiguero. 
Reference 2: O02 — Canastos — tres funciones. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE whole woven basket turned slightly on its side is the single symbolic carrier. Its woven rim curves into the natural elongated SNOUT outline of a giant anteater from V19, while the dark gap inside contains a small neat paper line of ants, not real insects spilling randomly. Basket-to-anteater is one original editorial metamorphic metaphor for a lost reciprocal gift and the new animal conduct. The whole combined outline visible, warm fibre paper and charcoal/ochre anteater with cream flank stripe, deep emerald surrounding earth. No people, hands, grotesque hybrid flesh, blood, ritual or many baskets.

VISIBLE CHECK: Un canasto cuyo borde se vuelve hocico de oso hormiguero, con hormigas en el vacío.
